svg.text: One MPU on the back of the hand + conductive-tape clicks + Bluetooth camera | No breadboard
EN open = ON; USB / BAT / VS / LBO
header pins are unused in this circuit.
Only plug in when charging; charge off-body.
Use the printed Arduino pin labels.
VIN and VUSB header pins: unused.
Mount firmly on the back of the hand.
Tape surfaces touch during each pinch.
Solder these 3 wire ends together; insulate.
Solder these 4 wire ends together; insulate.
G1 and G2 are labels for wire joints.
The Nano's two GND pins are connected
internally. The USB cable also carries GND.
REMOVE THE OLD NANO VUSB -> CAMERA 5V WIRE before using this battery circuit.
To program/test the Nano: unplug its PowerBoost USB cable and connect the laptop's USB data cable instead.
Keep the camera powered by the PowerBoost. Never join the laptop USB 5V supply to the PowerBoost output.
Pin labels are schematic labels, not physical pin positions. Build with battery and USB disconnected; plug the battery in last.
Circuit checked against manufacturer documentation. Combined battery operation and motion/click hardware are not yet bench-tested.
Sources and full numbered connection list: firmware/README.md | 24 October 2026
